questions.question: how do I check my account balance?
questions.answer: You can view your real-time balance on the main Dashboard after logging into the web portal or mobile app.

questions.question: what is my routing number?
questions.answer: Our routing number is 123456789. You can also find it printed on the bottom left corner of your physical checkbook.

questions.question: how do I report a lost or stolen credit card?
questions.answer: Go to Accounts > Cards > Lock/Report Stolen immediately in the app, or call our emergency hotline at 1-800-555-0199.

questions.question: how do I transfer money to another bank account?
questions.answer: Navigate to the 'Transfers & Payments' tab, select 'External Transfer', enter the recipient's routing and account number, and confirm with your OTP.

questions.question: what are the daily ATM withdrawal limits?
questions.answer: Standard accounts have a daily ATM withdrawal limit of $1,000. Premium tier accounts have a limit of $3,000 per day.

questions.question: how long do domestic wire transfers take?
questions.answer: Domestic wire transfers initiated before 3:00 PM EST are typically processed on the same business day.

questions.question: what should I do if I forgot my password?
questions.answer: Click the 'Forgot Password?' link on the login page, enter your registered email address, and follow the password reset instructions sent to you.

questions.question: how do I download my monthly account statement?
questions.answer: Go to Statements & Documents, choose your account, select the desired month, and click 'Download PDF'.
